title: claude-persona personas.json
description: Personas for the persona plugin of Claude Code. The plugin reads $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/personas.json, then ~/.claude/personas.json.

default.description: The persona a session starts with when CLAUDE_PERSONA is not set. Must be a key of personas.

personas.description: Personas by name. /persona <name> switches to one.

logins.description: Claude logins by name, each the config folder that holds its sign-in. /persona login <name> moves the session to one.

description.description: Shown by /persona, and used to guide compaction.

instructions.description: Added to the end of the system prompt while the persona is active.

mcp.description: MCP servers, by the name /mcp shows (claude.ai Gmail, plugin:context7:context7).

skills.description: Skills, by the name the skill listing shows (my-plugin:my-skill, agent-browser).

filter.description: Leave the field out to keep everything of that kind. * matches any run of characters. /persona check lists the names.

allow.description: Keep only these names. [] hides all of them.

quiet.description: Skills only: left out of the listing, but a call still works.

color.description: A color name (cyan), a hex value (#ff8800), or a theme key (success, warning, claude, suggestion).
